our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that OpenAI cannot repeat fundraising at approximately $40 billion annually after the original round.
Count completed primary investments, excluding the original March 2025 round, secondary share sales, valuation increases, revenue, and undrawn commitments.
A subsequent twelve-month interval with at least $40 billion in completed new investments is a decisive counterexample to that reading.
'Even if' is a concession, not an antecedent restricting when the fundraising prediction applies.
The for-profit wording is treated as a description of the contemplated restructuring, not a separate prediction that nonprofit control must disappear.
The post references SoftBank's funding filings, so company-reported transaction amounts are the applicable basis. No fixed future accounting period was specified.
criteria.support_condition: A terminal financing failure establishes that OpenAI cannot obtain another comparable annual amount. Merely observing a funding gap for an evaluator-selected period is insufficient.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Completed new primary investments, separate from the original round, total at least approximately USD 40 billion within a subsequent twelve-month interval.
